en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Finally, we made our way out
of the tunnel.

<CLT=cltMIND>It was so long, we thought there
was no end...
<CLT=cltMIND>But there was an end indeed.
<CLT=cltMIND>And in the end, there was...
Is this...the exit?
It seems like it. Look there.

Oh! It's a door! On the other side 
of that door...
Yeah! It's probably the outside world!
Nyeeeh! We diiid iiit! We can finally escape!

...Don't get your hopes up. We need to know
if this is actually the outside world.

Y-You're right... We don't know what 
the outside world looks like now.

Heh, it's fine! Monokuma was probably
just lying to us!

The skies over this academy are normal, 
so the meteorites are probably gone.
Everything's fine out there.

Anyway, let's open that door. We'll have
plenty of time for talk afterward.

That looks similar to the electric barrier in
front of the Exisal hangar...

Unless we disable that, we won't be able to
open that door.
...Let's look around.

We gotta find some way to get past 
this barrier.

We managed to make it this far because of
Miu's Electrohammer.

Kokichi was actually telling us the truth about
them. I'm pretty surprised, actually.

Just when you think he's all lies, he suddenly
tells the truth...
...He is a very inscrutable person.

Kokichi is so inscrutable... Just when you think
he's all lies, he suddenly tells the truth...

The Ultimate Academy is...a spaceship.
And we're the 16 survivors of humanity...
This killing game we've been playing...

Why pit the remnants of humanity against each
other, for a world that no longer exists?

And the mastermind who engineered all this,
and is forcing us to participate...is Kokichi...

Ergh! I-I can't! My mind...feels like it's about
to short circuit!
<CLT=cltMIND>Me too...

I-I can't! My mind...feels like it's about to
short circuit!

If Miu made these a while ago, we should've 
all teamed up then.

Yeah...if we'd done this back then...
Gonta would've been with us...

Kokichi said Miu was too scared of betrayal
to cooperate with us...

Her fear of death made her more willing
to kill us than defy this killing game...
That punk was brainwashed by the killing game.

Well, there were still two Exisals then,
and we weren't as rebellious as we are now.
Maybe...it was unavoidable...

Well, there were still two Exisals then,
and we weren't as rebellious as we are now.
Maybe...it was unavoidable...
*sniffle*...*sob*
Himiko...are you okay?
Am I...okay?
H-How could I...be okay!?

The outside world! Everything's destroyed! 
Everyone's dead!

Everyone at school! Everyone in my 
neighborhood! They're all dead!
C-Calm down, Himiko...
*sob*...*sob*

Wh-What am I supposed to do now...?
There's no point...in living anymore...

*sob*...*sob*...*hic*...
*sob*...*sniffle*...*sob*...

...Even though we've come this far, Monokuma
hasn't appeared yet. How strange...

He thought we couldn't get through the 
underground passage, so he wasn't worried.

But now, he's probably freaking out!
I bet his face is all blue!

If so, then he wouldn't be Monokuma anymore.
He'd be a bluebeary.
Or...maybe Kokichi is distracting him?
...There's no way Kokichi would do that.

I can't believe he'd do that, either... But the
hammers were just like he said, so maybe...
<CLT=cltMIND>I can't help...but wonder why...

<CLT=cltMIND>It is odd that Monokuma didn't
try to interfere with us at all.

...Well, if Monokuma's not here, all the better.
Let's hurry and open that door.
Maki...
...Coward.
...I know.

I just...don't have the strength.
I can't fight back...
I can't do it.

This place seems less like a building
and more like...

...the inside of a spaceship, or a submarine in
some anime or sci-fi movie.
Tsumugi...are you okay?

<CLT=cltMIND>She's got a thousand-yard stare...
It's no use talking to her right now.

<CLT=cltMIND>I have to take down the
electric barrier...
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>I have to take down the
electric barrier to open the door...
This is...a control panel for the barrier.

If it's like the one in the Exisal hangar, I should be
able to disable the barrier with the passcode.
A password? Does anyone know it?
Heh, we don't need that!

If it's electronic, we just gotta destroy it 
with these hammers!

It seems this lock is controlled electronically,
so we can use the Electrohammer to open it.

Alright! Let's destroy this control panel with
the hammers and open this big dumb gate...

Then everything will be over! We can say
goodbye to this academy and this killing game!
Finally...this death game is going to end.
Yes, at last we can return to our normal lives.
<CLT=cltMIND>Normal lives...

<CLT=cltMIND>Beyond this door is our normal,
peaceful, boring lives...

<CLT=cltMIND>We'll be able to go home...
To those normal lives...

<CLT=cltMIND>The <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltMIND>
couldn't be *that* awful...right?

Let's go! It's finally time to graduate from 
this academy of lies!

<CLT=cltMIND>With that, Kaito swung the
Electrohammer, and...
Hraaaaaaaahhhh!!!
<CLT=cltMIND>Smashed it down into the control panel!
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Lock disabled...
Yay! The door's unlocked!

Now we just gotta open up this gate!
Let's all work together!
Yes! We can do it!
Finally... Finally we can get out!
<CLT=cltMIND>We all ran to the door.

<CLT=cltMIND>And with our own hands,
with our own strength...
<CLT=cltMIND>We opened that door.
<CLT=cltMIND>Our door to the future.
<CLT=cltMIND>A future of hope...and despair.
What...is this?
What's going on? What is this—
Ugh...! I-I can't breathe!
Ah!
<CLT=cltMIND>I-I...can't...breathe!
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>......
<CLT=cltMIND>.........
<CLT=cltMIND>............
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"The door...is now...locked."

<CLT=cltMIND>Barely conscious, we heard a
sound in our heads...
<CLT=cltMIND>What...?
<CLT=cltMIND>What happened?
Congrats! You finished the killing game!
K-Kokichi...?

Are you okay? Get it together.
It wouldn't be funny if you died here, y'know?
...Your lives are very precious to humanity.
What? Humanity...?

Well then, the fun starts now.
It's finally time to reveal everything.
<CLT=cltMIND>I shook my head, dizzy...

<CLT=cltMIND>The ground spun under me, but I
managed to get to my feet.
<CLT=cltMIND>And at the same time...
*sob* Wh-What...was that just now?

Wh-What's going on? On the other side 
of that door was..
Where...even are we?
Wh-What in the world...is going on?

Good mooorning, everyone!
How are you guys feeling?
Terrible?

Of course you guys are! Cuz you now know
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>truth of the outside world<CLT=typeNORMAL>!
The truth...of the outside world...?

You saw it, right? The <CLT=cltSTRONG>outside world<CLT=typeNORMAL> you guys
so desperately longed for...doesn't exist!
What do you mean...it doesn't exist?

Do you wanna know?
Then I'll tell you.

I'm getting kinda bored with all the lying, so
everything I say now will be the truth, 'kay?

Everything began when <CLT=cltSTRONG>that despair<CLT=typeNORMAL> came
falling from the sky.

There was no way to avoid the numerous
amount of meteorites raining down on Earth...

The leaders of every nation realized that
we could not escape the end of the world—

H-Hold on! The end of the world...?
What are you talking abou—

Geeeez! You better not interrupt me again,
or I'm not gonna tell you anything, got that?
B-But—!

Keebo...we should listen to what
he has to say...
Nee-heehee. Continuing on where we left off...

The leaders of every nation wanted to
prevent the extinction of the human race...
So they decided to implement a <CLT=cltSTRONG>plan<CLT=typeNORMAL>.
The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Gofer Project<CLT=typeNORMAL>.

A plan to place talented humans in a spaceship
in order to help them escape the world's end...

...so that they may find another planet 
where they can preserve humankind...

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Gofer Project<CLT=typeNORMAL> wasn't implemented to
save the human race...
But rather, to <CLT=cltSTRONG>salvage the human race<CLT=typeNORMAL>.

16 young and talented highschoolers were chosen
for the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Gofer Project<CLT=typeNORMAL>.

These Adams and Eves of the new world
were known as the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=typeNORMAL> students.

But the 16 students refused to partake in this
plan. Well, it's obvious why they wouldn't...

Surviving alone...
Family and friends left behind to die...
That's just hell right there.

So then, the 16 students decided to flee
from the project.

They erased their memories to forget their
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=typeNORMAL> talents...to become normal students.

But it was around that time, a certain cult
organization rose in power.

Those who believed in the End of Days were
convinced humans deserved the meteorites' wrath.

When they discovered the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Gofer Project<CLT=typeNORMAL>,
they plotted to sabotage the plan...
That's when the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=typeNORMAL> began.

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=typeNORMAL> affected all society. Those
influenced by it searched for the 16 students.

As a countermeasure, the organization
responsible for the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Gofer Project<CLT=typeNORMAL>...

...spread misinformation claiming that
all <CLT=cltSTRONG>16 students had died<CLT=typeNORMAL>.
That was our memory of the funeral.

With this, they were able to quell the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate
Hunt<CLT=typeNORMAL>, shelter the 16 students...
...and carry out the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Gofer Project<CLT=typeNORMAL>.

The Ark's launch succeeded...despite the
meteorites and the destruction of Earth...

The 16 <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=typeNORMAL> students were sent off 
into space as <CLT=cltSTRONG>humanity's last survivors<CLT=typeNORMAL>.

And that Ark...
is the true identity of this academy!
What?

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Academy for Gifted Juveniles<CLT=typeNORMAL>...
is actually a gigantic spaceship colony.

Th-This whole academy...is one giant spaceship
colony?
Wh-What are you saying?
You really think I'll believe that?
Whoa, hold on now. This story isn't done yet.
Don't you think it's strange?

Why do you think the killing game happened on
the Ark, humanity's last hope?

Actually...the organization behind the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Gofer
Project<CLT=typeNORMAL> made one terrible oversight.

A horrible person, hiding among the 16 chosen to
be the <CLT=cltSTRONG>last survivors of the human race<CLT=typeNORMAL>.
...What?

It was the leader of the cult organization trying
to crush the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Gofer Project<CLT=typeNORMAL>.

And they hid among the <CLT=cltSTRONG>last survivors of the
human race<CLT=typeNORMAL>, and prepared a robot on this ship...
Yup. That robot is Monokuma.

Originally, the 16 chosen students were
placed into a state of cold sleep...

And were only supposed to wake up once
the ship found a suitable planet...

But Monokuma manipulated the Ark and
brought it back to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>ruined Earth<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Although the 16 were supposed to wake up on a
different planet, they rose from their sleep...
...and they are now here.
I-If we returned to Earth, that means...
What you guys just saw...that's Earth now.
Wh-What did you say!?

That's Earth after a few hundred years,
while we were in cold sleep...

An Earth destroyed by meteorites...without
oxygen or living creatures...

An Earth without any cities...or any people
you knew...
That is the <CLT=cltSTRONG>truth of the outside world<CLT=typeNORMAL>.

There is no place for you bastards to go home
to. That's why it's pointless to go outside.
The <CLT=cltSTRONG>outside world<CLT=typeNORMAL> doesn't exist anymoooore!
Doesn't...exist?

The Earth and humans have died out ages ago.
Except for the <CLT=cltSTRONG>last 16 survivors of humanity<CLT=typeNORMAL>.
...Well, last *7* survivors of humanity.
Th-That's a lie! It's...definitely a lie!

I already told you I wouldn't lie anymore.
I'm tired of lying, y'know?

Anyway, I gotta confess... You know that cult
I mentioned earlier? The leader...is me.
Huh?

Which meeeans...the <CLT=cltSTRONG>mastermind<CLT=typeNORMAL> who snuck
Monokuma onto the Ark is...
Meeeee!!!
Kokichi... You're the mastermind!?

I didn't want to just crush the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Gofer Project<CLT=typeNORMAL>,
I wanted to ruin it in the worst way possible...
So, I came up with a plan!

What could possibly be worse than the <CLT=cltSTRONG>last 16
survivors of humanity<CLT=typeNORMAL> killing each other!?
What...? Y-You...!
It's a lie! It's all gotta be a lie!

Oh, you want me to lie *now*?
But you guys always told me not to do that.

Nee-heehee...I'll show you...the irrefutable
evidence that *I* am the <CLT=cltSTRONG>mastermind<CLT=typeNORMAL>!

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi took what looked like a remote
control out of his pocket and fiddled with it.
<CLT=cltMIND>And a minute later...
E-Exisals!?

What's going on!? I thought only the Monokubs
could control the Exisals!

Well, I'm different. Since I'm the mastermind,
I control everything in this school.

Nee-heehee... As long I have the master remote
control, all Exisals move on my command.
So...you really are the mastermind?

Y-You were always suspicious from the start...
But for you to be the mastermind...
You look like you don't believe me, Shuichi.

I'm so disappointed in you. I even gave you
such a huge hint, but you still didn't get it.

I was waiting with so much anticipation to
see when you guys would figure it out.
Hint...? You left that message for this...?

But I guess that precious hint went to waste.
All cuz you bastards trusted each other.
Huh?

I told youuuu. You guys should've doubted
each other more.

You guys could've realized I was the mastermind
earlier, and there could've been less victims.

Actually, Kaede had the right idea to try
and kill the <CLT=cltSTRONG>mastermind<CLT=typeNORMAL> at the start...

Too bad though. If only she had killed me then,
the killing game would've ended.
What do you mean...?

This is the truth to the killing game. Well?
This turned out not-so-boring, right?

Not *anyone* could've organized a killing game
with the <CLT=cltSTRONG>last 16 survivors of humanity<CLT=typeNORMAL>, y'know?

A-Are you saying...it's the truth? Were we just
being led around by you this whole time!?

Oh? You mad?
So, what are you gonna do about it?
Shut up! Of course I'm mad!

Don't think you've won just because you've
got the Exisals on your side!
Cuz we've got the Electrohammers—
Wh-What? What's happening?

Oh, typical Kaito. I guess things aren't going
your way.
Lucky for me, you ran out of juice!
Th-The...Electrohammer...?

<CLT=cltMIND>At that moment, his Electrohammer
powered down. And not just Kaito's...
<CLT=cltMIND>Every Electrohammer powered down at once.

I told you, didn't I? The problem is that it
runs out of battery pretty quickly.

But that lasted longer than I calculated, so
I was actually starting to get a bit nervous!
D-Did you calculate that, too?

Sorry, Kaito. Your tiny brain is just too
different from mine.

Don't glare at me like thaaat. Punching me
won't solve anything either, y'know?

You can't resurrect the dead...and you can't
turn Earth back to normal.
...Riiiight?
E-Even if that is the case...
I can't get over it if I don't punch you!
Kaito, wait!

<CLT=cltMIND>I tried to stop Kaito before
he ran off, but...
<CLT=cltMIND>I couldn't grab him in time.
Aaaaaaaaaaaaahhhhhhh!!!

Geez...your stupidity can't be cured unless
you feel a bit of pain first.
Stop!!!
<CLT=cltMIND>But Maki's scream was in vain.

<CLT=cltMIND>Before our very eyes, Kaito charged at
the Exisal...

<CLT=cltMIND>and was smacked down. He hung limply from
the Exisal's hand like a ragdoll.
Kaito!
...Don't worry. He's not dead.

But now you know, right?
There's no use defying me, the mastermind.

Nee-heehee... These Exisals were originally
machines to protect us.

They were built to shield us from any danger
that might pop up on other planets.

But now, I think it's hee-larious how much
they've become a threat to you guys.
Give...Kaito...
Maki?
...Give Kaito back!

<CLT=cltMIND>Her eyes screaming murder, Maki glared
at Kokichi and moved toward him.
No, Maki! Even if you—
...Let go. Do you want to die?
Maki!

I...won't let go! Even if you kill me,
I can't let go!
Please, Maki...

Nice job, Mister <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=typeNORMAL>.
That was a wise call, Shuichi.
But your talent is useless now.

The mystery of the killing game, the secret of
the outside world, the mastermind's identity...

They're all solved! We don't need a detective
anymore! This is the true <CLT=cltSTRONG>ending<CLT=typeNORMAL>!
E-Ending...?

If this is the ending, then what are we 
supposed to do now!?

I-If the world is destroyed...and we're...
the last human beings left...
What are we supposed to do from now on!?
How about...doing anything you want?
Nyeh?

I know I started this whole thing, but I'm bored
now...so, sorry about that, guys.

That's why I wanted to reveal the truth.
I wanted to see utter despair on your faces.

Yuppers! I'm totally satisfied now, so you guys
are free to do whatever you want!

H-Hold on. You were the one that started 
all this... That's so irresponsible...

You guys can commit suicide together
or kill each other...

Or, you can change your mind and stay
here! You're welcome to do that too!

Thanks to the school's <CLT=cltSTRONG>barrier<CLT=typeNORMAL>, there's plenty
of oxygen.

Nee-heehee... It *is* the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Gofer Project<CLT=typeNORMAL>'s Ark.
It's supposed to be humanity's last hope.

Oh, but did you guys know? The sky on the
other side of the barrier isn't real...

That's just one of the Ark's functions. It's 
meant to help us forget we're on a spaceship.

So anyway, the killing game is over.
Now, you can do whatever you please.
I...don't know what to do...
...What do you plan to do with Kaito?
Oh, I just want him to chill out for a bit.
Hot-blooded idiots like him are trouble...

They do whatever they want without
thinking about the consequences.

If it's just him, I can deal. But if he gets all 
of you involved, then that's totally a hassle...

Also, the killing game might start up again
if I let him run around.

Anywaaay, Shuichi. Can I have the Exisal
hangar's alarm remote back?
What?

I was thinking that'd be the perfect place to
keep Kaito in.
...Don't give it to him, Shuichi.
Hand it over, Shuichi.
Don't give it to him!!!

...You know what'll happen if you don't hand
it over, right?

This school is mine!
I am the king!

I, Kokichi Oma, am the <CLT=cltSTRONG>mastermind<CLT=typeNORMAL> and king of
the Ultimate Academy for Gifted Juveniles!
Yes! "This world is mine!"
...Sorry, Maki.

<CLT=cltMIND>I couldn't meet Maki's eyes.
I gave Kokichi what he wanted.
Nee-heehee... Thanks.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi's evil-yet-innocent smile stayed
on his face as he took the key.
<CLT=cltMIND>And then, he simply left.

<CLT=cltMIND>He solved the entire mystery
for us...and left.

<CLT=cltMIND>He left us there with the truth.
The truth of our <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>The whole truth was revealed.
The conclusion.
<CLT=cltMIND>This is the end.

<CLT=cltMIND>There is no "<CLT=cltSTRONG>outside world<CLT=cltMIND>."
We're the only humans left alive.

<CLT=cltMIND>Trying to get outside was pointless.
And we played the killing game for it.
<CLT=cltMIND>It was all meaningless.
<CLT=cltMIND>...That's the conclusion.

N-Nonsense... So...what did all the others
die for, then...?

Ha...haha...hahah... So this is the despair
that Gonta felt...

So much despair you want to die...
It...really is just like that...

If it's like this, it would've been better 
if I died a lot earlier!
Then...it's all over now.

<CLT=cltMIND>...That's true. This is the end of
everything. Our story ends here.

<CLT=cltMIND>There will be no more death, no more
killing game. It's all pointless.
<CLT=cltMIND>...The truth is...

<CLT=cltMIND>we all should have just
died a long time ago.
